title: finding(tests): the comment projection at three `packages/types` readers is inert on every subject the tree has — removing it entirely changes nothing, so nothing would notice it being lost
body:
The comment projection at three `packages/types` readers is **inert on every subject the tree has today**. Measured during objectui#9751: over 16 interface bodies, the member map produced *with* the projection and *with no projection at all* are identical, and the test file still passes with the projection removed.

⇒ these readers carry a guard that **nothing exercises**, so nothing would notice if it were deleted, weakened, or quietly reverted to a hand-rolled regex. ⛔ That is not a claim the guard is wrong — it is correct, and objectui#9761 just moved it onto `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs` with zero behavioural risk precisely *because* it is inert. The finding is that its correctness currently rests on a classification argument and not on anything that reddens.

## The carriers

- `packages/types/src/__tests__/overlay-node-slot-doc-types-7082.test.ts`
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/alert-dialog-read-dialect-7104.test.ts`
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/overlay-trigger-union-7081.test.ts`

Each strips comments out of a `.ts` source before counting interface members. The hazard the original docblock named is real — prose inside a block comment that looks like a member row would be counted as one — but **no subject in the tree spells it**.

## Why this is its own card and was not folded into objectui#9761

⛔ Adding a forcing fixture inside that pull request would have mixed a **behaviour-preserving conversion** with a **new assertion**, and afterwards a reviewer could not tell which of the two any test result was about. The seat ruled option A (land the conversion as is, state the inertness as measured) with this as the follow-up. Record: objectui#9751's ACCEPT and landing comments.

## Sketched direction (⛔ not chosen — a triage call)

Give the projection something to defend: a fixture interface body carrying a member-shaped line inside a block comment, pinned so the member count is wrong when the projection is removed. ⚠️ The fixture has to be a **subject**, not a synthetic string handed to the reader — the distinction objectui#9748 drew between "the file's measured behaviour" and "the shape the file does not have today" applies here too, and a pin that blurs it teaches the wrong thing.

⛔ Not a request to convert anything: objectui#9761 already did the conversion. ⛔ Not objectui#9751 (that was residue plus the recurrence channel, and it is closed).

## Provenance

Surfaced by objectui#9751's dev as an open question after its reverse ablation came back green, ruled by the `domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat, `session_015h79niBMyoB1xcaQje3uiz`, R73, 2026-09-18. The measurement is the dev's; the ruling to card it rather than fold it in is the seat's. ⛔ This seat does not grade, route or prioritise.
